notes.title: The Beach - A Brand New Stage (V2.3.0)
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]This is a bit of a big one, today we’ve launched the first new stage since release, The Beach. It features 8 new levels, a new enemy and a load of different obstacles and hazards. Structurally and narratively the new stage comes after the final level (and credits) in the main game. In this new stage The Last Kick Bastard and the remaining minions of Hell decide to head to the beach for some well earned rest and a bit of beach based fun.[/p][h3]Additional Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Tweaked some of the visual effects like the screen shake and camera tilt to make the game feel more fluid.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some small tweaks to the ‘feel’ of the character controller to improve the overall experience of jumping and moving around on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some of the climb-up/ vault logic to allow you to move the camera a lot earlier after initiating the move such that it is easier to follow it with a wall kick or another move (and it also generally just feels more responsive now as a result). [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some of the climb-up/ vault checks to make them more robust which means they better catch edge cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked some of the detection logic on the kick (when kicking off walls) to improve the overall consistency and align the result better with the expected behaviour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you would sometimes start wall running just after you had initiated a climb-up/ vault.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on the Apocalypse double generator level that resulted in only one of the generators needing to be destroyed in order to progress after you had restarted the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that let you rebind the mouse look to another button but then you would not be able to rebind it back to the mouse axis. Now you simply click the input box and then move the cursor outside of the input box to have it bind to the mouse axis.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small text note to the level select to inform everyone about the gameplay options that exist.[/p][/*][/list][p]Now go check out the new stage and levels. Have fun kicking![/p][p]~ Ian[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: V2.2.0 - HUD Overhaul and Movement Upgrades!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41225571/2669cbb0b37b902ab545223a826cfeb56ffa34de.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone, I’ve got a new update for you! The highlights are: a new and improved HUD that looks way nicer and gives you a load more useful info, and some changes to the movement that will shake up the game and will probably enable you to beat all the current leaderboard times in the game. Below is a full list of the changes to the game:[/p][h3]General:[/h3][list][*][p]Improved performance for Location Unknown levels so they are now pretty inline with the other stages in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added in level ‘death markers’ that show the positions of some of your latest deaths in the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of medals you need to progress past the locks in the campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]Created a new player death animation and updated the death effects.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI:[/h3][list][*][p]Repositioned HUD elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Created a speedometer so you know how speedy you are.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the look of the enemy takedown HUD element.[/p][/*][*][p]Created a medal tick-down HUD element that shows you how long left to get the next possible medal.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new HUD message system that highlights important stuff and some less important stuff too.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some level stats to the level complete screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a note of how many shoeboxes you need to unlock the next virtual level in the level complete screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped the continue and main menu buttons around on the level complete screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The credits now take you to the level select screen now instead of the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller navigation for the level select screen and fixed some associated issues.[/p][/*][*][p]When using controller navigation in menus you can now hold down the buttons to quickly move through the menus.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Options:[/h3][list][*][p]Added options to disable some of the new UI features (under the accessibility tab).[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to disable the level locks in the level select screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to hide the tutorial components in the game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Player movement changes:[/h3][p]The goal of these changes is to improve the consistency of some of the moves at higher speeds and to improve the viability of different moves when performed at higher speeds. Ideally this will mean that fast lines now don’t end up being a game of trying to maximise the number of slide hops you do.[/p][list][*][p]Added the speed boost visual effect created in the last patch to: the climb up, dash kick, wall kick, super kick, jump out of the wall run, the start of a wall run and the jump out of a grapple swing.[/p][/*][*][p]The climb up now gives you a small 1.075x boost as you exit the move.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the conditions for starting a wall run so you will retain more of your speed at higher speeds and steep angles.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting a wall run now gives you a small speed boost of 1.05x.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the wall kick in 3 ways to improve consistency and power across different speeds: 1. At higher speeds the kick will move you slightly more in the direction you are currently travelling vs the direction the wall is facing. 2. Increased the distance you can kick at a little bit when you are at higher speeds. 3. Made the kick boost you an even 1.135x regardless of the speed you are currently travelling at (this should feel the same as before at lower speeds but much much better at higher speeds).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the grapple exit animation wouldn’t properly transition, meaning the hands would try running in the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped the lava flashing while playing on an intel graphics card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the levels in Hell P2 to show a flat yellow surface instead of the lava.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that reverted the simplified lava setting back to the default when moving to a new level or changing the quality setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bugs with the level lock system in the level select screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some lighting issues on some of the levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buses de-spawning too soon on Hell 13.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that let you restart last second on the takedown levels to get a super low time.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]I hope you all have a great time with the new changes and please do let me know if you have any thoughts or opinions on anything that’s changed![/p][p]~ Ian[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: V2.1.0 - Super Kick Mode, UI Upgrade and More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, been a while but I’m back with a reasonably chunky update. I’ll jump right into the details but first if you have a chance we have put together a survey to get a sense of what kind of updates you all might like in the future. Check it out here: [url=https://forms.gle/idmcLTwUzDgmHLwS7]https://forms.gle/idmcLTwUzDgmHLwS7[/url]

Now for the update details!

[h2]Super Kick Mode[/h2]
We've added a new mode called Super Kick that you will unlock at the same time as the Spider-Person mode (it will be automatically given to you if you have already got the Spider-Person mode). What it does is give you infinite wall kicks while you are in the air and updates the floor kick to work similar to the wall kick. However there is a cost to this new power, when walking you will move at a very slow pace so make sure to stay in the air and slide whenever you land on the ground. As with Spider-Person mode you will need to play through all the levels in order to unlock them and each level has a new leaderboard for the new mode.

[h2]UI Update[/h2]
The main update you will notice here is that the ‘Play’ menu no longer exists (and the multi save system has been dropped in favour of this system) and it is replaced by a new and greatly improved level select screen. This should make the process of playing through the game a lot more enjoyable and it will make it a lot easier to quickly get to specific levels you want to play. It also features a new level lock system to help encourage some more people to get involved in the leaderboards and hopefully get the most out of the game (it’s at its best when you're trying to improve your times and challenging yourself). My goal for this is to keep the requirements fairly low and just generally have a light touch with the locks so if they are really annoying or hard to beat please let me know!

[h3]Full list of UI changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to select the font size.
[*] Improved the look and feel of the menus & UI across the whole game.
[*] Added some additional options to the first time load option menu.
[*] Changed the in-game name of the shoeboxes to shoeboxes instead of collectables.
[*] Tutorial Improvements
[*] For long term players this won’t make a huge difference to your experience of the game but for new players the initial experience of the game will be greatly improved. There is a new tutorial ‘line’ which helps to give context to the tutorial prompts and in many cases has meant that I have been able to reduce the word count on them. There is a new smaller tutorial prompt for these reduced tutorials too.
[*] I have also reordered a few of the early levels to help the learning flow. Level 3 is now level 6 and level 5 is now level 7.
[/list]

[h2]Movement Changes[/h2]
There are a few small movement / control changes.

[list]
[*] Added quick turns to the game, by default they are on Q & E, these are designed to help with skills like the backwards wall kick for players who want them.
[*] Adjusted the default keys for the front and back flips for m&k to Z & F to make room for the quick turns.
[*] Improved visual effects for the slide hop and made a custom jump sound for it.
[*] Slightly adjusted the jump sound to make it a little clearer and nicer sounding.
[*] Adjust the roll in two ways: speed up the roll animation a tiny bit (and alt animation too), this doesn’t affect the functionality but does make it feel a lot better and allow you to see again faster after the roll. Secondly I adjusted the timing of the roll button press requirements to allow the roll to be activated later. Now if you press the button up 0.1s after you land it will still activate, changed from the moment you land.
[/list]

[h2]Misc Changes & Bug fixes[/h2]
Made the wizards more accurate at longer ranges so they feel more consistent to play against.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the 100% Steam achievement would not unlock.
[*] Fixed the bug where the virtual completionist would not unlock.
[*] Fixed a bug where bugged near 0 times would sometimes be added to the leaderboards when you restarted a level at a very specific time.
[*] Fixed an issue that let you kick while the stage titles were playing.
[*] Fixed the time display bug on the level end screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the level end screen did not scale to fill the screen when the leaderboards weren't present.
[*] Added collisions to some boxes missing them in BTH-07.
[*] Fixed an issue where the grapple would attach to two points if you tried to grapple again quickly after having let go at a distance far from the previous attach point.
[*] Fixed an issue with the downwards wall jump that meant you would sometimes reattach to the corner of the wall.
[*] Back to Hell 06 was accidentally removed in the last build so added it back into the game. (Sorta counts newish content if you really think about it lol)
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update and please do check out our survey if you can!!
~ Ian (Come chat with me on the Discord about the update if you wanna :) )

notes.title: Kick Bastards 2.0 - MASSIVE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We've got a massive update for you!! Welcome to Kick Bastards 2.0! We've made loads of changes to the game and added a bunch more content. Here are the highlights: we've added 15 new levels to the game, added a brand new mode, 'Spider-person mode', which lets you play through all the levels using a grappling hook that you can attach anywhere (replay LU-2 and LU-3 first for the best experience) and we've also made improvements to (almost) all the existing levels in the game (from small changes to full overhauls).

[previewyoutube=pLPaHsHvnAk;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is the full list of changes:

[b]Movement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made some small tweaks to how the player feels to move around.
[*] Updated the grapple functionality so that holding the grapple key will now pull you in towards the grapple point. Pressing the jump key is now the only way to release the grapple. (Also updated associated tutorials on LU-2 and on new LU-3)
[*] Added a grapple icon so it's clearer when you can use the grapple.
[*] Made the conditions for starting a wallrun more lenient so it will work when you expect it to more often.
[*] Removed the minimum time on the wall before you can jump out of a wall run.
[*] Added a climb up buffer so that the climb up will feel considerably more consistent.
[/list]

[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 8 excellent new Apocalypse levels, 5 new Hell P2 levels and 2 Location Unknown levels.
[*] Updated (almost) all the levels with visual improvements, clarity improvements and gameplay improvements. In some cases we did large overhauls to dramatically improve the levels.
[*] Added a brand new mode, 'Spider-person mode', which lets you play through all the levels using a grappling hook that you can attach anywhere. (I'd strongly recommend replaying LU-2 and LU-3 before jumping into this!)
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new platinum medal and shuffled the times so that bronze is the default when you aren't fast enough for the other medals.
[*] Created new medal icons.
[*] Updated the results screen to make it easier to navigate and to be more fun!
[*] Improved the level restarting system to make it a quicker and generally smoother experience.
[*] Fully rewritten the dialogue. It's much better now.
[*] Updated the tutorial prompts to be less verbose.
[*] Updated the save system to support multiple game saves.
[*] Added an outline to all stuff that is kick-able to make it clearer that you can kick that stuff.
[*] Added some additional secrets to some of the levels.
[*] Updated the level select screen to be easier to navigate and to display the next virtual level to be unlocked with a lock on it.
[/list]


[b]Bug fixes and performance improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed mouse cursor disappearing when using the scroll bar in the level select screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wizard wouldn't always look at you when shooting fireballs.
[*] Did some additional performance improvements to the buses.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tutorial wouldn't appear at the start of a level when using the don't play dialogue option.
[*] Fixed bug where sliding up a slope and spamming jump would cause you to gain excessive speed.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it so you needed to click an extra time on the Devil cut-out dialogues.
[/list]

notes.title: Improved performance and new tutorials - Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got quite a big update for you today, mainly featuring bug fixes and stuff but also some changes to address some issues that some of you may have had. The key takeaways are we upgrade the project engine version to improve performance, we’ve improved the tutorialisation in a bunch of places (go check out all 3 new tutorial levels!) and we’ve added a bunch of new options to the game to help you customise your experience.

I hope you all like the changes and if you have any questions then head over discord or pop them here on the forums!

This is the full list of changes in detail:

General:
Upgraded the project to Unreal 5.3 so that we can have better performance as our temp fix for the sparkly bug had a noticeable effect in this department. (This is the reason for the big patch size too, sorry!)
Made it so you can spam through the dialogue more easily.
The music no longer restarts when you restart a level.
Improved the mantle so that it will function better in more niche scenarios.

Tutorials:
Added 2 new hell levels to teach slide hopping and back kick.
Added Virtual_00 a new tutorial level to help explain some of the more advanced mechanics in the game.
Added some additional tutorialisation for the grappling hook to 2_02

Leaderboards:
Added in an indicator to the level end screen which shows which leaderboard rank you are currently on.
Added titles to the medals and collectable for a bit of added clarity on what they are. (also added a coloured lapel to the dev medal for consistency)
Fixed an issue so that the correct leaderboard will always display for the level you are on / looking at.

Levels:
Updated 5-04 with some tweaks to make it a bit easier and clearer in areas where people have been getting a bit stuck.
Made Hell_06 collectable easier to get to.

Options:
Added an option to adjust the resolution scale.
Added an option to use a simplified lava material. (This will prevent the lava flashing bug that a few people experienced)
Set camera smoothing off by default for m&k and added an option to enable it for m&k and a second option to enable/disable it for controller.
Added an option to turn off dialogue and stage titles.
Added an option to skip level end screens and to automatically move onto the next level.

Misc:
Made the building guy's voice affected by volume sliders.
Fixed an issue where the achievement for 100%ing the game wouldn’t always unlock. (If you have already 100% completed the game and the achievement hasn't unlocked then completing any level will unlock the achievement for you).

notes.title: Experience fast paced parkour and kicking with the developers of Kick Bastards!
notes.notes:
Kick Bastards is skill based parkour game where you overcome every problem with a kick. Kick bad guys, kick down doors, kick everything you can. The game is fast paced and dynamic, you'll need to dance through danger by avoiding obstacles and mastering the levels.

Race through different realms in your quest to be the fastest in the universe with multiple unique stages each with their own set of levels and mechanics.
